column9: Remote-first global team, no country/work-auth/timezone clause — geo OPEN. Strong Node.js/React/Docker match; tRPC, SSR and TypeScript unevidenced on cv.md. Pay band 50-150USD/hr explicitly "based on experience and location" and G2i has documented location tiers ($50 US vs $35 non-US on Tier 3) — real geo-discount risk. Body says contract up to 6 months while Ashby chip says Full time; resolve at screening before discussing rate. Agency/marketplace model, no equity or promotion path. Target #222 (Staff, 120-200USD/hr) first — same board, same funnel, floor 2.4x higher.
